## How I checked it

- [ ] `npm run verify` passes locally (or explain what you couldn't run)
- [ ] Tests added or updated at every layer this touches (unit / rules + functions / end to end)
- [ ] Data-model changes have matching security rules **and** rules tests, including what must be denied
- [ ] Works with existing data (or migrates it) and stays inside the free quotas (no unbounded reads)
- [ ] User-facing change noted in `CHANGELOG.md`; new Google Cloud APIs added to `scripts/services.txt`
- [ ] No secrets or personal data (project ids, emails, `.env` files)
